system_boundary.spatial_reference: Illustrative named study boundary only; no coordinates or actual study area are asserted.
included_processes: On-site rainfall capture and runoff movement
excluded_processes: Upstream embodied impacts of construction materials
Downstream catchment effects beyond the study boundary
system_boundary.cut_off_rules: No omitted process may be interpreted as zero. Document all cut-offs and expand the boundary if they could reverse the comparison.

functional_unit.service_definition: One year of the explicitly defined corridor service within the declared spatial and temporal boundary; no actual performance value has been collected.

mycelix.boundary: Stores evidence provenance, versioned claims, rights state, and review history; does not itself prove source truth or consent.

symthaea.boundary: Proposes mechanisms, alternatives, and falsifiable questions; does not authorize designs or turn assumptions into measured outcomes.

symtropy.boundary: Runs explicitly versioned physical scenarios; outputs stay modelled until independently calibrated and validated against appropriate observations.

sol_atlas.boundary: Maps scenarios, boundaries, uncertainty, distributions, and provenance; does not convert a visual layer into evidence or approval.

limitations: Protocol-only record; no actual Johannesburg energy, water, material, emissions, thermal-comfort, or service data have been collected here.
Boundary, functional unit, cut-off rules, baseline, intervention set, and evidence requirements require local review before assessment.
No overall symtropy score, optimization result, safety clearance, or community endorsement is implied.
